refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to create a leafe node with a specified value

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeCreateFromValue function generates a new leaf node from source. The value in source is copied, and the calling context is responsible for managing source after a call to SilikoNodeCreateFromValue.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoNodeCreateFromValue returns a pointer to a new leaf SilikoNode object with a copy of the value passed on success, or NULL if there was a memory error.
